methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $41M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 4 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.1B - $2.0B.

data.narrative:
First Resonance is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $40.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of nine private robotics and manufacturing firms at Series A/B stages, plus one public comparable (277810.KQ), with peer sample including Generalist AI ($2.0B Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), and Walden Robotics ($1.1B Seed).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($41M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A progression, implies a valuation of $82M. Peer-median analysis across the four sampled comparables yields a median valuation of $1.7B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $2.0B. The disparity reflects stage and maturity differences within the comp set—the peer median includes more mature Series B companies, while First Resonance remains pre-Series B.

The triangulated valuation range is $69M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $891M. This wide band reflects meaningful uncertainty around which comparables most appropriately anchor valuation at this stage. The stage-progression method suggests a near-term floor, while peer medians may overweight later-stage companies. Key uncertainties include First Resonance's revenue trajectory, competitive positioning relative to peers, and runway efficiency relative to the broader Robotics & Manufacturing cohort.
